_about: Public-domain J. R. Graves (James Robinson Graves, 1820-1893, Baptist editor, Nashville and Memphis, leader of Landmarkism) for the Word Hoard: The Watchman's Reply (1853), The Great Iron Wheel (1855), The Tri-lemma (1860), Old Landmarkism: What Is It? (1880), John's Baptism (1881), two published debates (with Ditzler, 1876, and Burruss, 1880), and The Work of Christ in Seven Dispensations with six shorter works, all seven known here only in the Baptist Sunday School Committee's Texarkana reprints (copyright 1928), raw Internet Archive OCR. Landmarkism and anti-Methodist polemic; veto point. Added 2026-10-10 by lane A, round 18 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
